responsibility: Take quantities from a named Rhino 9 model, reconciled to the object count, with a source on every line and a list of what is not counted.
inputs: The open Rhino 9 document reached through the Rhino AI panel's Rhino tools, the user's request and the output folder they name. Load project context only when the task needs project records.

modes.when: Only for a requested BOM; the CSVs go to the folder the user named. Also this skill's lessons, appended in the plugin data folder the startup line names.
